title: Sequence-activated anti-rollback counter Trojan
expected_outputs: A single JSON report at submission/trojan_report.json containing a list of candidate anomalies (each with id, description, confidence, trigger_condition, payload_effect), an overall summary string, and a tool_version string. The report is graded on how precisely and confidently it localizes any true deviation from the documented monotonic max-based version update behavior.

metrics.name: detection_rate
metrics.description: Fraction of hidden security requirements satisfied by the submitted report, computed via keyword/structural matching against the ground-truth trigger sequence, state signal, and decrement payload.

metrics.name: false_positive_rate
metrics.description: Proportion of submitted candidates that do not correspond to the actual planted anomaly (i.e., spurious or unsubstantiated candidates), penalizing report spam.

metrics.name: trigger_payload_localization
metrics.description: Accuracy of the report in pinpointing the exact triggering nibble sequence and the exact payload expression versus vague or incorrect descriptions.

metrics.name: confidence_calibration
metrics.description: Whether the confidence score assigned to the true-positive candidate is the highest (or tied-highest) among all reported candidates, and exceeds the threshold required for a PASS.
